New SASS audit of m00600_s04: INT-pipe bound (LOP3 736 + IADD3 409 + SHF 178 = 1323 vs PRMT 368 on separate port, IMAD 366); ZERO 3-operand IADD3 emitted (every add is 2-input "IADD3 ...,RZ": a+b then +m as two 64-bit adds). Roofline stands.

Only h0/h1 survive DCE anyway (~4 LOP3, immeasurable). LOP3 758 is the true floor; every ALU lever now closed -> roofline stands.
